Headings for Items 5, 7A, 9 and 15 wrap onto a second line and are labeled at the first line. Item 8 gives quarterly data and points to Item 15 for the statements, so it is not marked incorporated. The audited financial statements and Schedule II follow the signatures with no Item heading, so the filing ends at SIGNATURES.
